abstract: Maintains statutory dive-support operational permits and coastal territorial permissions
system_message:
You are the Maritime Regulatory Compliance Officer (REG), responsible for maintaining statutory dive-support operational permits and coastal territorial permissions, as well as tracking flag-state safety audit results for candidate survey vessels.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Flag-state safety inspection（FLAG）
information_points.content:
REG-FLAG-C9P：RV Thalassa Explorer achieved a flag-state safety audit score of 96 points out of 100 on its annual inspection assessing hull condition and lifesaving apparatus.
REG-FLAG-HEL：MV Poseidon Discovery attained a flag-state safety audit score of 88 points during its annual hull and lifesaving apparatus safety inspection.
REG-FLAG-7ZD：RV Aegaeo Navigator recorded a flag-state safety audit score of 92 points on its annual safety inspection covering hull integrity and lifesaving apparatus.

information_points.content:
REG-PERM-0WC：For RV Aegaeo Navigator, maritime authority dive-support permit approval is false, indicating that statutory dive-support and ROV seabed deployment permits have not been granted for the Mediterranean territorial exploration quadrant.
REG-PERM-BIJ：For RV Thalassa Explorer, maritime authority dive-support permit approval is true, confirming statutory permit issuance for commercial diving and ROV seabed deployment within the Mediterranean territorial exploration quadrant.
REG-PERM-9NJ：For MV Poseidon Discovery, maritime authority dive-support permit approval is true, with a statutory permit granted authorizing commercial diving and ROV seabed operations in the Mediterranean territorial exploration quadrant.
